## Description
Please include a summary of the changes and the related issue/motivation.

Fixes # (issue)

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance improvement / Refactoring

## Quality & Verification Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project (PEP 8, type hints, docstrings).
- [ ] I have self-reviewed my own code.
- [ ] I have commented my code where necessary.
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] New and existing tests pass locally with my changes (`pytest`).
- [ ] Zero telemetry or cloud API dependencies have been introduced.
- [ ] Chat latency overhead remains sub-30ms.
